content:
manny_support: FYI — oncall just handed us a customer escalation: several hosted-api customers seeing intermittent 502s and long tail 504s starting ~22:07 UTC. high-level: /v1/generate requests failing.

leo_sre: seeing it in SLO dashboards too. spike in edge_inflight_count and a lot of upstream resets from Envoy: "upstream reset before response completed".

tim_eng: any common model or route?

manny_support: customers report models: redwood/sea-11b and redwood/shore-4b, mostly streaming requests. one customer sent a repro curl: 
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood/sea-11b","input":"short prompt","max_tokens":64,"stream":true}' \
  https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/generate
```
results in HTTP/1.1 502 and connection reset after ~5s.

leo_sre: logs show this pattern: 
```
[envoy] upstream reset: connection failure to upstream cluster upstream-host-42:504 - TLS handshake? 
[edge-proxy] inflight_per_route=2048, connection_queue=0, upstream_pool_exhausted=true
```

chun_p: interesting — I see auth-cache hit ratio drop around same time (auth_cache_miss_rate spikes). lots of revalidations to auth-tier which increases latency to upstreams.

tim_eng: could be cascade: auth misses -> more long-lived connections -> KV cache warmups -> upstream threadpool contention -> Envoy resets.

manny_support: customers are hitting us with parallel streaming sessions (SSE). one reported 600 concurrent streams from a single client.

leo_sre: check envoy config: max_connections_per_host and per-route max_requests? also look at `upstream_local_cache` and keepalive settings.

tim_eng: running a quick query on metrics:
- edge_inflight_total peaked at 12k (baseline 2k)
- envoy_upstream_reset increased x8
- auth_cache_miss_rate 0.27 -> 0.74
- upstream_response_time p95 jumped to 8.4s

chun_p: we recently rolled a small auth change 3h ago (auth TTL tweak). could be related. rollback slated?

manny_support: customer-facing: sending status note and workaround to reduce concurrency.

leo_sre: immediate mitigations I recommend: 
1) increase envoy upstream connection pool temporarily (+20%)
2) bump edge_proxy.max_inflight_per_route lower? actually throttle per-API-key to stop single clients from saturating
3) enable fallback to smaller model (shore-4b) for streaming until auth cache stabilizes

tim_eng: I can push a quick rate-limit tweak for the top offending API keys and add a temporary circuit-breaker for routes with inflight > 1k. prepping PR now.

deploy-bot: deploy started by tim_eng: edge-ratecap-hotfix -> staging -> canary -> prod (tracking #DPL-3219)

manny_support: assigned follow-up to tim_eng and leo_sre. I'll keep customers updated.

leo_sre: also adding an alert: auth_cache_miss_rate > 0.5 && edge_inflight_total > 8k -> page oncall.

tim_eng: rolled hotfix to staging, canary looks good (no increase in 502s during canary window). rolling to prod in 2 min.

manny_support: sent customers an interim note: "We are throttling heavy concurrent streams per API key to stabilize gateway. Working on permanent fix." :thumbsup:

chun_p: long-term actions: revert TTL tweak if confirmed root cause, add auth cache warmup on deploy, and add docs for recommended client concurrency for streaming endpoints.

leo_sre: marking thread resolved when 2h of stable metrics and no customer reports. tracking in incident tracker INC-20255.

manny_support: closing loop — prod stable for 23m, edge_inflight back to 1.9k, envoy_upstream_reset normalized. customers acknowledged.

tim_eng: will open a postmortem PR with repro steps and perf graphs. assigning to leo_sre and chun_p for root cause analysis.
